ApprovalMode.description: Node accepts only `implicit`; anything else means none.

ApprovalProvideSecretParams.description: Secret answer of a human-gate `provide-secret` request (today's `provideSecretInput`); never part of a decision or a log record.

BlobPutParams.description: One upload chunk; raw chunk ≤ `limits.maxBlobPutChunkBytes`. The blob is complete when the bytes received hash to `digest`.

BrowserStreamParams.description: Params of `browser/stream` (a phone's request, Node's `browserRemoteStream`): `on` starts or stops this connection's stream of the browser session. The first stream of a session makes the core send `host/browser/viewFrames{on:true}` and the last one `{on:false}`; the phone's live-view signals name only a session it streams. `request` is the stream request (fit, quality) the core hands on to the host unchanged.

BrowserWebrtcSignalParams.description: A phone's live-view signal (`browser/webrtcSignal` request, Node's `browserRemoteWebrtcSignal` call) and the core's signal to that phone (the `browser/webrtcSignal` push, Node's `browserRemoteWebrtc` event). `signal` is the validated wire object of `mixdog-remote::webrtc::signal` (`ClientSignal` / `DesktopSignal`).

version.description: Must equal the core's `serverVersion` (version gate, no ranges).

ConfigSetBotOrderParams.description: Params of `config/setBotOrder`. Node rejects more than 500 ids, or an id that is empty after trimming or longer than 128, with `usage: setBotOrder(an array of agent ids)`; an empty list clears the stored order.

oneOf.description: Write only when the path holds no value; the compare is inside the write transaction.
`notifications.devices.<id>` only: the value is a partial record merged onto the stored one, `events` and `quietHours` key by key; a device with none stored starts from the default record.
As `mergePatch`, but a device with none stored starts from the phone-app default (bot chats only).
`notifications.overrides` only: the value is `{target, setting}`; the target's entry is replaced, or removed when the mode is `inherit`, and expired mutes are dropped.

DownloadSource.description: What a paired phone asks to download (`transfer/authorizeRead`).

oneOf.description: A file of a conversation's project, by its path in the project.
A file a conversation names, by its absolute path; `projectPath` is the conversation's project, if it has one.

FeedPosition.description: A client's last position in a feed.

FeedSubscribeParams.description: Generic subscription to a scoped feed whose id the client already knows (`login:<flowId>`, `media:<jobId>`, `lsp:<root>`).

GitDeleteBranchInput.description: Input of `git/deleteBranch` (`gitDeleteBranch(cwd, branch)`): a local branch.

GitRequestContextInput.description: Input of `git/requestContext` (`requiredGitRequestContextInput`): the listed repository-relative files (0–500, may be empty) and an optional base branch.

base.description: Absent or empty: no base branch.

HostCapabilities.description: The desktop host role (DS §12.2): what this connection serves for the core.

files.description: File snapshots and the local page server.

media.description: May send X17 binary media frames.

HostClaimParams.description: Claims the host role for this install (`hostId` generated per install).

HostRemoteTargetSetParams.description: SSH server core the local core bridges phone connections to (R25).

endpoint.description: `ws://127.0.0.1:<port>/rpc` of the tunnel; absent = the local core.

HostStateSetParams.description: Publishes desktop-owned state into section `hostState`: `{key, value}`, the value's shape picked by the key. Only `visualize` is typed; the others stay the desktop's own JSON.

approvalsInbox.description: Receive every pending approval request even without a thread subscription (P §8.3).

optOutNotificationMethods.description: Exact notification methods suppressed for this connection.

ItemsCursor.description: Opaque cursor, or an item anchor (today's `before`/`after` row reads).

root.description: The project root; the feed is `lsp:<root>`.

ModelProxyRunParams.description: Electron → its local core: execute a proxied call.

allowedProviders.description: The providers this server may use through this PC: the host's saved list, `null` for every provider enabled here. Always sent: a message without it is refused, never read as every provider.

runId.description: Stream id the local core stamps on `modelProxy/run/event`.

fallbacks.description: The Lead's ordered fallback models; `[]` clears, absent keeps.

onlyIfEmpty.description: Compare-and-set: applied only while the target route has no model.

fence.description: Record every unknown id newer than the watermark as fenced before answering.

owner.description: Answer the registered Project's real path even when `path` names a managed worktree of it.

accessToken.description: A paired device's one-file grant, as on `projectFs/readText`; the window then captures the granted file alone.
A paired device's one-file grant, as on `projectFs/readText`.
A paired device's one-file grant, as on `projectFs/readText`; the page then serves that file alone.

ProjectFsPreviewFileParams.description: Params of `projectFs/previewFile`: what a paired device's file preview needs to know before it reads (Node's `previewProjectFile`).

accessToken.description: A paired device's one-file grant, as on `projectFs/readText`.

ProjectFsPreviewRangeParams.description: Params of `projectFs/previewRange`: one bounded window of a previewable file (Node's `previewProjectFileRange`).

accessToken.description: A paired device's one-file grant (`transfer/grant/mint`): `root` and `rel` are then Node's `projectPath` and `relPath`.

authorized.description: Read as a paired device does (Node's `readProjectTextFileAuthorized`): the file is opened first and the open file is checked.

fromChar.description: Answer only `maxChars` code points of the text, from code point `fromChar`; the answer then carries `nextChar` while text remains.

readId.description: The `readId` the first window's answer carried: the windows after it are served from that one read of the file (the file is not opened again), so a file replaced between two windows does not mix versions.

accessToken.description: A paired device's one-file grant, as on `projectFs/readText`.

viaHost.description: The OS trash is the desktop window's (Node's `trashItem` host request): the core confines the path and asks the window.

accessToken.description: A paired device's one-file grant, as on `projectFs/readText`.

PromptContent.description: Today's `DesktopPromptContent`: a string or an array of parts.

PromptPart.description: One part of a prompt (today's `DesktopPromptContent` array form).

oneOf.description: A text, or a stored text attachment: an `attachmentRef` part has no `text` and names its `textKind` (`paste` or `file`), as Node's `handoffContent` forwards it.

data.description: Base64 bytes; a part that names a stored `attachment_ref` instead has none.

ProxyBinary.description: A file part's bytes. The sender's attachment-store reference means nothing on the PC, so it is never carried: the sender inlines the bytes (under its byte budget), and a reference that stays travels as `unavailable`.

ProxyCall.description: What the remote runtime asks of the PC's providers (`ModelProxyProvider`, `quota-reading.mjs:93`, `loadModelProxyProviderConfig`).

updates.description: `(message index, effort)` pairs; a JSON object would key them by text.

ProxyOptions.description: `RequestOptions` field for field. The connection scope and the model's output ceiling are the PC's to derive, so they are not carried.

agent.description: An agent/tool session, or a send carrying tools.

legacy.description: A session that predates the wire table (`model-proxy-provider.mjs:193`).

anyOf.description: Items of the newest turns up to n, 1 ≤ n ≤ 512.
Header and runtime sections only; `none` is always `true`.

ResumeWindow.description: Closed window descriptor of a thread subscription (P §6.3).

ReviewDiffGetParams.description: One read for every review family (DS §5.3).

known.description: The client's review key; an unchanged review answers `{unchanged:true}`.

summary.description: Leave the patch text out of a turn review (today's `getTurnReviewDiff {summary: true}`).

ScreenDisplaysParams.description: Params of `browser/screenDisplays` (a granted phone's request, Node's `browserRemoteScreenDisplays`) and of `host/screen/displays` (core → host): none. Both answer `RemoteScreenDisplaySummary[]` (`apps/desktop/src/shared/remote-webrtc.ts`), unchanged.

SubmitOptions.description: Caller options of `turn/start` (today's `DesktopSubmitOptions` without the host-only fields `device`, `hop`, `roomRow`, `origin`; a request carrying any of them is `invalidParams`, P §4.3).

attachmentSizes.description: The stored files' sizes by `attachmentRef`, which the message's attachment records take in place of a part's claimed `sizeBytes` (`attachmentBlobSize`). Host-only, like `context`.

clientSubmissionId.description: Today's submit `id`: the client's correlation id reused by queue and transcript.

context.description: The agent tool's `context` of a queued follow-up (`submitAsync` option `context`): kept on the queue entry as Node keeps it. Host-only: a connection's request carrying it is `invalidParams`.

retryAttemptId.description: The failed attempt of that message (`retryAttemptId`).

retryTurnId.description: The failed user message a retry replays from the model history (`retryTurnId`).

ifIdle.description: Today's `deleteSessionIfIdle` expectation (e.g. `{lastUsedAt}`); not idle → the reply `{deleted: false, reason}`, never an error.

intoThreadId.description: Inherit into this existing empty thread (today's `inheritFrom`); absent creates a new thread.

threadId.description: The source thread; it is never changed.

currentText.description: The composer's text when the entry is handed back (today's `restoreQueued` first argument): the reply's `text` ends with it.

queuedId.description: Absent with `restore`: every queued entry is handed back (today's `restoreQueued` with no id).

restore.description: Hand the entry back to the composer.

ThreadResumePosition.description: Thread resume position: replay requires an equal window (P §6.3 rule 3).

ThreadSessionOptions.description: The session options Node's `createMixdogSessionRuntime` takes (headless exec sets all of them, `headless-exec.mjs` `createHeadlessSessionRuntime`). Stored in the thread's header.

approvalMode.description: Node default none: approvals go to a person. Under `implicit` every approval ask is denied at once with Node's text, as when no approval UI is wired.

autoWakeCompletions.description: Node default `true`: finished background work wakes the session.

disallowDelegation.description: Node default `false`: the session may not delegate to agents.

memory.description: The memory feature switch for this session (`MIXDOG_FEATURE_MEMORY`).

webSearch.description: The web-search feature switch for this session (`MIXDOG_FEATURE_WEB_SEARCH`).

oneOf.description: The desktop's control session (Node's `ensureControlSession`, created with `desktopSession: null`): it runs in the task workspace, carries no classification and, while empty, is not listed. Rust name: `ThreadStartKind::Control`.

initialInput.description: Starts the first turn in the same request (today's `submitNewTask`).

session.description: How the session runs; absent is an interactive session (Node's defaults).

TransferAuthorizeReadParams.description: Params of `transfer/authorizeRead`: the first stage of a phone's download, a grant that expires.

sessionId.description: The conversation the phone names: the grant and the transfer it becomes end with it (Node's `Grant.sessionId`).

TransferEndReadParams.description: Params of `transfer/endRead`: the transfer, or the unredeemed grant, to release.

version.description: A phone's read names the version it leased; another is `changed`.

TransferRedeemGrantParams.description: Params of `transfer/redeemGrant`: the second stage, which consumes the grant once into a transfer.

TransferSource.description: What a read transfer opens; the real path is verified after open.

oneOf.description: An absolute path the connection may read (server windows, granted local files).
A one-file grant minted for this paired device (`transfer/grant/mint`), redeemed with the path Node's file calls name (`projectPath` + `relPath`).

restorePrompt.description: Rewind a submitted prompt only when the composer was empty at cancel.

turnId.description: Absent: the thread's active turn (Node's `abortSession` named none), or, with none running, the idle stop.

expectedTurnId.description: Absent: the core steers the thread's active turn (today's `prioritizeQueued` names none).

VisualizeAnnotation.description: The agent's mark on displayed pane `pane` (selectors and labels only).

VisualizeGoneOpen.description: An open of a finished turn whose tab had nothing left to show.

VisualizeHistoryItem.description: One thing opened in a session (open or since closed); path-free.

at.description: When it was last opened (ms since epoch).

VisualizeHistoryKind.description: The pane kinds and inline kinds a history entry can show, or a `split` of several.

VisualizeHostEvent.description: `VisualizeHostEvent` (`apps/desktop/src/shared/visualize.ts`), main → core: the change `DesktopVisualizeEvent` carries, with host paths.

held.description: Sent while the session's agent turn runs.

tab.description: With `reveal`: the tab the open or update was for.

updated.description: A content update of this tab.

VisualizeHostPane.description: A pane with the symlink-resolved file it shows.

path.description: `""` for an `inline` pane, which has no file.

remoteRenderId.description: Inline panes: the render id a remote client's report must carry.

remoteTarget.description: What a remote client is told the target is.

root.description: The folder this pane's file and page assets must stay inside.

VisualizeHostState.description: One session's tabs with their resolved files.

active.description: Always written; `null` when no tab is active.

cwd.description: The working directory every pane and page asset must stay inside.

remoteLabel.description: The label a remote client sees.

version.description: The version shown instead of the live files; `null` = live.

VisualizeHostValue.description: What the desktop publishes under `visualize`: the visualize service's `hostSnapshot()` (every session's state, sent again on each claim) or one `publishRemote` change event.

deferred.description: Always `true` when present: a device's snapshot left the source out.

VisualizeProblem.description: One distinct runtime problem of a tab's HTML pane; `source` is project-relative.

pane.description: Index of the pane (in the tab's displayed panes) it came from.

VisualizeVersionTurn.description: One agent turn's span (ms since epoch).

VisualizeVersionView.description: One kept version of a tab's files (`n` counts up per tab from 1).

at.description: When it was kept (ms since epoch).

description: Request from a client to the core.

oneOf.description: Subscribes the app feed; replay or `app/snapshot`.
Subscribes a scoped feed whose id is known (`login:`, `media:`, `lsp:`).
Outcome of mutations whose response was lost; `fence` makes `notApplied` final (P §9.4).
One page of a blob; not a mutation.
One upload chunk; content-addressed, not a mutation.
Model catalog rows; pager of section `modelCatalog`.
Secret answer of a `provide-secret` human gate.
One route write for a thread, an agent or the default (R15). `route` is a `ModelSelection` or today's route value.
Fast mode for a thread or the default (R15); `toggleFast` is a client-side flip.
New thread; with `initialInput` also its first turn.

The only call that creates a thread subscription (P §6.3). A relay phone subscribes through Node's relay-handled `setVisibleSessions` (`remote-relay-client-calls.ts`), which the inventory maps to this call and `thread/unsubscribe`.
Ends the subscription; never stops work (X10).
History pages; never changes a subscription.
Delete; `ifIdle` answers `{deleted: false, reason}` when not idle, never an error.
Inherit into a new or an empty thread; the source is untouched.
Answers when the compaction turn has started.
Stop every background shell job of the thread.
Start, or queue on a busy thread (X9).
Abort; C0 bypass, reply before durability (D-L1).
Prioritize a queued entry into the running turn.
Today's session configure action `setBotOrder`; answers the order as stored.
Snapshot read; section `agentPool` is the source.
Today's `agentRoomAction('reset', …)`: the room's log starts over, its members' sessions are emptied.
Several key writes in one transaction.
Recompute section `providerSetup` (today's `getProviderSetup` options); the section carries the result.
Desktop updater check/install from any client; the core forwards `host/update/command`.
Remove; drops watches, LSP and processes under it internally.
Read a text file (replaces the `In`/`Authorized` variants; origin rules apply).
Move an entry to the OS trash.
Read an absolute path the connection may read.
Stat absolute paths (single and list form).
Rendered snapshot of a file by the desktop host (`host/capture/fileSnapshot`).
URL of the desktop host's local page server (`host/localPage/url`).
What a paired device's file preview reads first: kind, mime, size, modification time and the media lease (Node's `previewProjectFile`).
One bounded window of a previewable file, base64 (Node's `previewProjectFileRange`).
Connection-owned watch; changes on scoped feed `fs:<watchId>`.
Sessioned fuzzy file search; results on `search:<sessionId>`.
New query for a search session.
Zip a folder (git-aware list, size cap) into a read transfer.
One page of an open read.
A paired phone's download, first stage: opens the file and answers a grant that expires.
A paired phone's download, second stage: consumes the grant once into a transfer.
A paired phone's download is done: the file must still be the leased version; the transfer ends either way.
Move a server entry to trash.
Mint a one-file grant for a paired device's path outside every project (Node's `rememberFileGrant`).
Every review read (turn, session, repo); `pending{key}` while computing.
Create or reuse a terminal tab.
This connection becomes the size owner.
Subscribe `ports`; the sampler runs only while subscribed.
Approve or deny a pairing claim.
Activate remote access, an explicit user action (Node `remote.start(true)`), and answer the full `remote` section value as it stands afterwards.
The full `remote` section value: the list method of the section when it is published as a stub.
UI-originated in-app browser control; forwarded as `host/browser/command`.
UI-originated visualize command and pane reads; forwarded as `host/visualize/command`.
Bridge phone connections to an SSH server core (R25).
A paired phone's WebRTC live-view signal (Node's `browserRemoteWebrtcSignal` relay call). The reply settles once every signal it caused was pushed (`browser/webrtcSignal`).
A phone starts or stops streaming a browser session (Node's `browserRemoteStream`).
The displays a granted phone may choose for the remote screen (Node's `browserRemoteScreenDisplays`): `RemoteScreenDisplaySummary[]` from the host.
